# Kerala Superstore Manchester

> Authentic Kerala Groceries & Spices UK — Delivered Direct to Your Doorstep.

Kerala Superstore Manchester is the leading South Indian and authentic Kerala grocery store in Manchester, United Kingdom, providing local same-day delivery across Greater Manchester and fast next-day courier delivery nationwide across the UK.

## Store Information
- **Store Name:** Kerala Superstore Manchester
- **Business Type:** Kerala Grocery Store, Supermarket, South Indian Food Importer
- **Physical Address:** Unit 2, 73 Old Market Street, Manchester, M9 8DX, United Kingdom
- **Customer Hotline & WhatsApp:** +44 7749 132122
- **Email:** info@keralasuperstores.com
- **Website:** https://keralasuperstore.com
- **Opening Hours:** Monday to Sunday, 09:00 - 21:00 GMT
- **Customer Parking:** Rear parking available

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Nationwide UK Delivery:** Fast courier dispatch across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Free UK Delivery on orders over £50.
- **Manchester Local Delivery:** Same-day & next-day doorstep drops across postcodes M1 to M9 and Greater Manchester (SK, WA, BL, OL, WN).
- **Payment Options:** Cash on Delivery (COD), Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Apple Pay, Google Pay.
- **Natasha's Law Compliance:** Full allergen declaration and ingredient clarity on all packaged spices, pulses, flours, and frozen goods.

## Product Inventory & Categories
1. **Rice & Grains:** Palakkadan Matta Rice (Nirapara, Double Horse, Pavizham), Kaima / Jeerakasala Biriyani Rice, Ponni Boiled Rice, Idli Rice, Sona Masoori, Kerala Red Rice.
2. **Spices & Whole Condiments:** Whole black pepper, green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon sticks, star anise, mustard seeds, fenugreek, dried red chillies, curry leaves.
3. **Curry Powders & Masalas:** Sambar powder, Rasam powder, Fish curry masala, Chicken & Mutton masala, Meat roast masala, Turmeric, Coriander, Kashmiri chilli powder (Eastern, Nirapara, Brahmins, Melam).
4. **Breakfast Staples:** Idiyappam podi, Puttu podi (white & brown rice), Appam / Idli batter, Dosa mix, Rava, Wheat flour / Chakki Atta.
5. **Traditional Pickles & Chutneys:** Tender mango (Kanni Manga), cut mango, garlic, lime, gooseberry (Amla), fish pickle, prawn pickle (Grandmas, Bravo, Nirapara).
6. **Kerala Crisps & Snacks:** Authentic Kerala Banana Chips fried in 100% pure coconut oil, Sharkara Upperi (jaggery banana chips), Murukku, Mixture, Kuzhalappam, Achappam.
7. **Pure Oils & Ghee:** 100% pure unrefined cold-pressed Coconut Oil (KPL Shudhi, Parachute, Eastern), Gingelly / Sesame oil, Traditional Cow Ghee.
8. **Fresh & Frozen Foods:** Frozen Kerala Parotta / Malabar Porotta, Frozen Kappa (Tapioca chunks), Frozen grated coconut, Frozen drumstick, Bitter gourd, Snake gourd.
9. **Hot Kitchen Specials:** Fresh weekend batches of Thalassery Chicken Dum Biriyani, Kozhi Porichathu, and evening tea snacks.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Where is the store located?** Unit 2, 73 Old Market Street, Manchester, M9 8DX, UK.
- **Can I order online?** Yes, orders can be placed online at https://keralasuperstore.com or via WhatsApp at +44 7749 132122.
- **Is Cash on Delivery available?** Yes, customers can inspect their delivery and pay in cash directly to the courier.
- **Is there a mobile app?** Yes, customers can install the lightweight Kerala Superstore App directly from the website for iOS Safari and Android Chrome.
